2608.13463.title: MLLM-Routed Heterogeneous Ensembles for Robust Cross-Dataset Image Classification
2608.13463.paper_summary: Modern image classification models excel when trained on single task-specific datasets but often struggle to generalize across domains and difficulty levels. We propose ARMDIL, an Adaptive Router for Multi-Domain Image classification with LLMs. ARMDIL is an ensemble that uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) agent to dynamically route each image to the most suitable vision backbone. Our diverse ensemble employs convolutional neural networks (ResNets), self-supervised representation learners (SSL), and vision-language models (VLMs), each trained on a unified label space constructed from multiple image datasets with differing distributions and characteristics. Empirical evaluations illuminate the distinct capabilities and vulnerabilities of each architecture across disparate visual domains. Crucially, we show that ARMDIL effectively navigates these trade-offs, performing competitively with specialized training-based routers. Furthermore, it drastically improves adaptability by allowing new information to be integrated via simple prompt modifications, while enhancing interpretability through natural language reasoning traces. These advances in cross-dataset image classification pave the way for more reliable general-purpose vision systems such as AI assistants and autonomous robots.
2608.13463.paper_summary_zh: 現代的圖像分類模型在針對單一任務特定數據集進行訓練時表現優異，但在跨領域和不同難度水平的泛化上往往面臨挑戰。<lb/>我們提出了ARMDIL，一種用於多領域圖像分類的自適應路由器，配合大型語言模型（LLMs）。<lb/>ARMDIL是一個集成系統，利用多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）代理動態將每個圖像路由到最合適的視覺主幹。<lb/>我們的多樣化集成系統使用卷積神經網絡（ResNets）、自監督表示學習器（SSL）和視覺-語言模型（VLMs），每個模型均在由多個具有不同分佈和特徵的圖像數據集構建的統一標籤空間上進行訓練。<lb/>實證評估揭示了每種架構在不同視覺領域中的獨特能力和脆弱性。<lb/>至關重要的是，我們展示了ARMDIL有效地導航這些權衡，並與基於專門訓練的路由器競爭性地表現。<lb/>此外，它通過允許通過簡單的提示修改來整合新信息，顯著提高了適應性，同時通過自然語言推理痕跡增強了可解釋性。<lb/>這些在跨數據集圖像分類方面的進展為更可靠的通用視覺系統鋪平了道路，例如AI助手和自主機器人。
